_readme: Editable project templates, in the spirit of CapCut / Google Vids starters.
A template describes the shape of a video: canvas, per-slot durations, transitions,
text overlays and an optional Director brief that pre-fills the agent.
Apply one from the Templates tab: it sets the render settings, fills slots from your
selected library assets (or leaves them empty as placeholders), and queues the render.

templates.name: Vertical Reel — 3-beat hook
templates.description: Hook, payoff, call to action. The default shape for TikTok/Reels/Shorts.
templates.director_brief: A 14-second vertical short. Open on a surprising visual hook in the first second, deliver the payoff in the middle, end on a clear call to action. Fast cuts, high contrast, no dialogue.

templates.name: Product hero — 5 shots
templates.description: Wide establishing, detail macro, in-use, benefit, logo card.
templates.director_brief: A 16-second product film. Premium, calm, natural light, shallow depth of field. Establishing wide, macro detail of the material, the product in use by human hands, a benefit moment, then a clean end card on a plain background.

templates.name: Photo slideshow — Ken Burns
templates.description: Stills become video with a slow push and crossfades. Add a music bed.

templates.name: Talking head + b-roll
templates.description: Speaker with cutaways. Pair with auto jump-cut and burned subtitles.
recommended_steps: Edit -> Auto jump-cut on the speaker clips

templates.name: Before / after split
templates.description: Two clips side by side. Good for restoration and upscale demos.
recommended_steps: Edit -> Split screen with the two clips

templates.name: Cinematic trailer — 6 beats
templates.description: Slow build to a title card. Wide aspect, long crossfades.
templates.director_brief: A 21-second cinematic teaser at 24fps. Anamorphic feel, heavy contrast, slow push-ins, long dissolves. Build tension across six beats and end on a stark title card over black.

templates.name: Explainer — 6 steps
templates.description: Numbered steps with on-screen titles. Add narration from the Director.
templates.director_brief: A 23-second explainer video with six beats: a title card, four numbered steps shown visually, and a summary. Clean, bright, minimal, plenty of negative space for on-screen text.
